stationId.description: Must match the station that currently owns the active claim. Must be non-empty: the API treats "" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.

quantity.description: RELOCATE and REPLENISH only (ADR-0047, ADR-0050): the units the operator counted and moved (RELOCATE v1 moves the whole on-hand quantity of the SKU at the source bin; REPLENISH takes the counted quantity, which may differ from the planned one). Required for a RELOCATE or REPLENISH task, rejected (422 `not-relocation-task`) for any other. A value below 1 is a 400.

fromBin.description: RELOCATE and REPLENISH only: the source bin the operator scanned. Required when a RELOCATE move left the source open (an Assign); when sent for a planned source (always for REPLENISH) it must equal it. A blank value (no character outside ECMA-262 `\s`) is a 400.

toBin.description: RELOCATE and REPLENISH only: the destination bin the operator scanned. Required when a RELOCATE move left the destination open (a Vacate); when sent for a planned destination (always for REPLENISH) it must equal it. A blank value (no character outside ECMA-262 `\s`) is a 400.
